newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts squashed between 114-14 and 112-29.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts squashed between 114-14 and 112-29.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE will be confined to a range of 114-14 and 112-29 on Friday after an inside day in the previous session suggested consolidation, technical analysts said.

"We had an inside day yesterday," said Elizabeth Miller, technical analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London. "That usually suggests uncertainty in the market. We expect the market to initially dip before climbing higher this afternoon."
Nearby support comes in around 113-20, congestion from the highs around there on June 20, 23, 24. Candlestick charts also show open and closes around this level on those days.
Gilts were quoted at 114-00 just after the open at 0700 GMT, up 2/32 from Thursday's settlement.

Miller said that if 113-20 failed to hold the contract, gilts would find an additional buttress at 112-29, the bottom of a triangle formation on daily charts which would be the main technical feature of trade over the next week.

On the upside, initial resistance came in at 114-04, a 76.4 percent retracement of the slide from the high of 114-18 on June 17 to the 112-25 low on June 24, she said. The contract tried to pierce that level on Wednesday and Thursday but failed. It was also the high so far this session.
The triangle formation provides stronger resistance at 114-14 which was likely to hold this session, Miller said.
Technical analysts at Chase in London said the price action below 114-04 had developed a corrective pattern for the chart, which would be broken to the upside.

"However, short-term gains should be limited by the trend and Elliott resistance intervening at 114-17/18 from where it should start to retrace recent gains witnessed from 113-25," they said in a research note.
December short sterling was quoted at 92.79, up 0.01 from Thursday.
